title: linux-admin 1.18.19 — HAProxy consolidated into load-balancer parent
summary: Top-level skill count is now 65. The former haproxy-expert is retired after its frontend/backend, ACL, health-check, stickiness, TLS and guarded reload guidance was preserved and expanded in load-balancer-expert/chunks/haproxy.md. F5, cloud load balancers, LVS/IPVS, keepalived/VRRP, NGINX proxy and DNS/GSLB remain distinct where their control planes differ. The latest published GitHub Release remains v1.17.74.
